subject: RE: Enquiry — does D153/1–8 contain a c.1875–1880 Llandough-juxta-Penarth instrument?

text:
Ref: 2026/4274

Dear Sion Buckler,

Thank you for your email received into our enquiries system 17th September.

The majority of your email relates to document reference D153/1–8.  As discussed in previous emails, this is a reference for material held at the National Library of Wales so you should contact them about these records.  Detailed descriptions can be found on their online catalogue: Deeds relating to premises in p. Llandough, co. Glam., comprising a dwelling house adjoining the churchyard, 1811 (D153/1-2), land (19 ..., - National Library of Wales Archives and Manuscripts<https://archives.library.wales/index.php/deeds-relating-to-premises-in-p-llandough-co-glam-comprising-dwelling-house-adjoining-churchyard-1811-d153-1-2-land-19>

The other part of your email quotes a document reference that appears to come from our collections at Glamorgan Archives but we are not sure if it is the correct reference for what you are researching.  D/DRa 11/120 is an old way of formatting our reference DRA/11/120.  This forms part of the series DRA/11/1-293 which comprises lawsuits, instructions to counsel, opinions etc. relating to undermining of house property, flooding, contravention of colliery regulations, 1856-1909 in respect of Elder’s Navigation Colliery, Maesteg.  This doesn’t seem relevant to your research and doesn’t relate to Tynywain either.  Can you point us to where you found this reference so that we can assist further with your questions about this particular item?

Yours sincerely,

Louise Hunt
Archifydd / Archivist

Archifau Morgannwg / Glamorgan Archives
Clos Parc Morgannwg
Lecwydd / Leckwith
Caerdydd / Cardiff

From: Sion Buckler <[email redacted]>
Sent: 17 September 2026 00:21
To: Glamro / Swyddfa Cofnodion Morgannwg <[email redacted]>
Subject: Enquiry — does D153/1–8 contain a c.1875–1880 Llandough-juxta-Penarth instrument?

EXTERNAL: This email originated from outside Cardiff Council, take care when clicking links.
ALLANOL: Daw'r e-bost hwn o'r tu allan i Gyngor Caerdydd, cymerwch ofal wrth glicio ar ddolenni.

Archivist,
Please would you check whether D153/1–8 contains any document dated c.1875–1880 relating to Great House Farm / Ty Mawr, Llandough-juxta-Penarth (ST 168 733), adjoining St Dochdwy’s churchyard.
This is not Great House Farm, Llandough near Cowbridge.

I am looking for an agreement, lease, counterpart, award, conveyance or related plan involving any of:

Daniel Thomas / D. Thomas & Son

Llandough Limeworks

John Williams / Thomas Williams

the Bute Estate or the Trustees of the Marquess of Bute

quarrying, minerals, lime, sidings, compensation or reparation

the dwelling adjoining the churchyard
Please inspect the full sequence D153/1–8, not only items already described as D153/4–8.

Catalogue titles may not name the parties. Endorsements, dockets and plans should be checked.

If such an item exists, please give:

the exact reference
date
document type
parties as written
property description and acreage
whether a plan is attached
whether a copy can be supplied, and at what cost

Also is there any item in D153/1–8 dated 1875–1880 naming Thomas Williams, John Williams, Daniel Thomas, Llandough Limeworks, or the dwelling by St Dochdwy’s?

Please confirm D/DRa 11/120 is Tynywain, Llanedeyrne, and not Llandough-juxta-Penarth/ Llandough Cardiff.

I do not need a searchroom booking at this stage.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler

Mae'n bosibl bod gwybodaeth gyfrinachol yn y neges hon. Rhaid deall nad yw'r safbwyntiau, y casgliadau a'r wybodaeth arall yn y neges hon nad ydynt yn cyfeirio at fusnes swyddogol Cyngor Dinas a Sir Caerdydd yn cynrychioli barn y Cyngor Sir nad yn cael sel ei fendith.
